entities.summary: Alcantarilha is a former civil parish in the municipality of Silves, Portugal. In 2013, the parish merged into the new parish Alcantarilha e Pêra. With an area of 19.54 square kilometres (7.54 mi2) the population of 2347 inhabitants is dispersed throughout the territory.
